how_we_work.title: From Sketch to Battery
how_we_work.sub: A proven process for startups and engineering firms.

steps.title: Tell Us What You're Building
steps.desc: Send voltage, energy, peak current, dimensions, temperature range, and quantity. Or just send your CAD drawing.

steps.title: Feasibility Review
steps.desc: We review cell selection, series/parallel configuration, mechanical fit, BMS, thermal requirements, charging, and connectors.

steps.title: Prototype Build
steps.desc: We build initial packs. Fast iterations — design changes measured in days, not weeks.

steps.title: Test & Refine
steps.desc: We test under real conditions and modify the design until it meets spec.

steps.title: Pilot Production
steps.desc: Start from 50 packs. UL, CE, UN38.3 and IEC 62133 certified as standard.

steps.title: Scale Without Switching
steps.desc: Go from prototype to production without changing suppliers. Same team, same quality.
